title: Preparation and characterization of fish skin gelatin and chitosan-based active dressings for skin wound healing
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5064-5078
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05902J, Paper

Jingjing Chen, Zhide Ruan, Jikun Pang, Chuanyan Pan, Haoyu Yang, Xu Luo, Qiyun Qin, Weihao Wei, Guangzheng Jiang, Min Lv, Huawei Ma
This study prepared an active wound dressing (AWD) based on fish skin gelatin and chitosan, and characterized its multiple properties including tensile performance, adhesion, thermosensitive responsiveness, and antibacterial activity.
